text.en: The following territory is created as a barrio in the Municipality of Mabini, Province of Davao, to be known as the barrio of Masara. It shall be bounded on the North by the Compostela boundary; on the South by mountain ranges; on the West by sitio Panibasan; and on the East by the Municipality of Caraga.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
